job_description: Data Analyst (junior to mid). You will query company databases with SQL, interpret results with basic statistics, build weekly dashboards and explain findings to non-technical stakeholders. Python is a plus.
candidate_background: Two years in operations reporting. Builds weekly spreadsheet dashboards, comfortable with Excel, has written simple SQL queries, presents results to the operations manager. No Python experience yet.

knowledge_questions.supported: What does a Data Analyst do?

interview.scripted_question: Tell me about a time you had to explain data findings to a stakeholder who was not technical.
interview.synthetic_answer: In my reporting job the operations manager did not trust a weekly backlog dashboard. I rebuilt the chart so each bar showed the same three categories he used in meetings, walked him through two examples and agreed a monthly review. He started using the dashboard in his Monday planning.
